name: nestjs-poc
description: NestJS + React showcase: a task manager API and UI

scripts.dev: npm run db:up && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.db:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec postgres psql -U tasks -d tasks
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
